title.narrative: Multi-Sector Humanitarian Response and capacity strengthening for Refugees, IDP and host communities in ND & East Sudan

description.narrative: Humanitarian assistance so that Refugees, IDPs and vulnerable (host) communities meet their basic needs and increase emergency preparedness in protracted and humanitarian situations in East Sudan and North Darfur states of Sudan.(1)Safe and adequate shelter, safety and emergency supplies.(2)Equal and sufficient access to drinking water as well as to sanitation and hygiene knowledge. (3)drinking water as well as to sanitation and hygiene knowledge (4) Improved protection.(5)Emergency preparedness

The objective of this project is for Refugees, IDPs and vulnerable (host) communities meet their basic needs and increase emergency preparedness in protracted and humanitarian situations in East Sudan and North Darfur states of Sudan.

The project targets 82,500 beneficiaries. The target of this project mainly Internally Dipslaces Persons (IDPs) resulting from the war that started on 14th of April, regular IDPs from previous attrocities in North Darfur, and regular refugees residing in refugee camps in the East of Sudan. To enhance peaceful co-existence among IDPs, Refugees and host communites, the project will also target those vulnerable people living in adjacent communities likewise.
